# Blue Archive Model Sources

These files are working copies imported from the user-maintained source folder at
`C:\Users\user\Desktop\Study\Y2S3\AIForGame\AIForGameModel`.
The originals remain unchanged in that folder.

## Character models imported for Humanoid compatibility audit

### Misono Mika

- Supplied creator: Halano
- Creator page: https://www.deviantart.com/halano
- Imported source files: `Halano/Mika/CH0069_Mesh.fbx` and
  `Halano/Mika/CH0069_Halo.fbx`
- Licence: Not included with the downloaded character files and not verified.
  Confirm redistribution and derivative-work terms before distributing it.
- Audit result: valid Unity Humanoid Avatar, skinned body, and separate embedded
  weapon renderer. Not yet added to the sandbox selector.

### Okusora Ayane

- Supplied creator: Halano
- Creator page: https://www.deviantart.com/halano

- Licence: Not included with the downloaded character files and not verified.

- Audit result: valid Unity Humanoid Avatar, skinned body, and separate embedded

### Hayase Yuuka

- Supplied creator: Halano
- Creator page: https://www.deviantart.com/halano
- Imported source files: `Halano/Yuuka/Yuuka_Original_Mesh.fbx` and
  `Halano/Yuuka/Yuuka_Original_Halo.obj`
- Licence: Not included with the downloaded character files and not verified.
  Confirm redistribution and derivative-work terms before distributing it.
- Import status: copied from the user-maintained source folder for Humanoid
  validation and sandbox integration. The separate halo OBJ is retained as an
  original working source but excluded from the preview prefab because its
  incompatible export scale overwhelms the character model.

## Downloaded files audited but not imported

- The Azusa and Koharu character downloads identify VuckyZ as the author and
  include CC BY 4.0 licence files. Their supplied glTF files contain meshes but
  no skin, skeleton, or animations, so they require rigging before use with the
  shared animation workflow.
- The separate weapons by yochan.176 include CC BY 4.0 licence files and require
  attribution if used.
